limits_and_decisions: Two seconds still starts before Engine::Search, so lock waiting and matching consume the existing authorization budget. Extending it silently is not a latency optimization and was not done.

A ranked first page with an exact authorized total still requires inspecting all relevant candidates. Stopping after 48 allows would corrupt totals/rank/page semantics unless the product/protocol explicitly supports partial counts and later completion; no such redesign is included.

ACL reads, impersonated opens, directory snapshot validation and final page rechecks remain fresh for every response. They can dominate local storage latency and are not eliminated by the raw candidate cache or shorter locks.

The attempted per-candidate shared-lock reacquisition and epoch-triggered empty response have been reverted. The stable shared snapshot can delay index writers during ACL I/O, preserving the prior complete-count and page semantics instead of introducing empty results under ordinary USN churn. The earlier 10.072 ms synthetic denial measurement applies to the superseded implementation.

Reducing engine lock hold across ACL I/O requires a stable snapshot or more precise identity/generation contract with deterministic writer-churn validation. No new version of that optimization is enabled in the current product.

Filename interning adds a transient hash node/view/offset per unique basename. Views do not duplicate name payloads, and the converter destroys the dictionary before the writer; actual real-snapshot working/private memory still needs measurement. Stage samples and PeakWorkingSetSize are not an exact dictionary allocation count.

The previous FullRebuild direct-write gap has been patched through WriteBuildIndexFile and the common interner. Targeted assertions for exact node/metadata preservation, byte-idempotent preparation, heap-fallback maintenance and invalid-reference nonmutation passed in the latest 48/0 suite; the original dependent NamePoolFixture passed separately 60/0. These isolated results do not yet establish that a production FullRebuild retains the reduced size. Explicit --intern still creates an independent converted snapshot for reviewed migration.

The standalone probe maps the base only and excludes WAL replay, active topology/configuration, live maintenance, UI/pipe scheduling and online concurrency. Its results explain aggregate computational/ACL stages, not full installed service latency.
No deployment, user-setting update or permission change was performed by this subtask.
